jeffery.kaynak: Arthur Jeffery, The Foreign Vocabulary of the Qur'ān (Baroda 1938; Brill yeniden basımı, yazıya geçirilmiş metin; Arapça yazılar yazı tipi bozuk olduğundan alınmadı)
jeffery.metin: iii, 146. Myriads. 1 Dalman, Worte Jesu, 267, and see his Grammatik des jüd. paläst. Aramäisch, p. 176. Hübschmann, Arm. Gramm, i, 376; ZDMG, xlvi, 251. 3 Mingana, Syriac Influence, 85, agrees, but see Horovitz, JPN, 200. 4 Fraenkel in Beit. Ass, iii, 74, says that Nöldeke suggested this derivation, but I cannot locate the reference. 2 foreign vocabulary of the qurn 139 The passage is a late Madinan one encouraging the Prophet in his difficulties. as-Suyūtī, Itq, 321, says that certain early authorities considered it a Syriac word, and this is probably correct. Syr. F!, the plu. of ! meaning myriads, translates both μυρίοι and μυριάδες of the LXX.1
